sources.entry: gathio - Self-destructing, shareable, no-registration event pages. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Gathio is a self-hosted, federated, privacy-first event hosting platform for creating shareable event pages.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very brief and describes gathio as a simple, federated, privacy-first event hosting platform. It points to a publicly hosted flagship instance and to a documentation site for usage and self-hosting setup. The source documentation lives in the repository's docs/ directory. The README does not list specific features, setup commands, or configuration details. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as self-destructing, shareable, no-registration event pages, and gives Node.js and Docker as the stack. Those specifics come from the listing, not the README.
use_cases: host an event page without creating an account
share event details with a group via link
run a private event page on your own server
how_to_run: See the documentation site linked in the README for setup instructions
Alternatively, read the source documentation files in the docs/ directory
notable: Publicly hosted flagship instance available to try
Self-destructing event pages, per the awesome-selfhosted listing
caveats: The README is minimal and gives no installation commands; setup details are in external docs
Platform and dependency details beyond the listing's Node.js/Docker mention are not stated in the README
